task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Accounts module in SuiteCRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the SuiteCRM Accounts list view or the Accounts module menu item being clicked.

task_completion.description: Agent filters the account list to show only those with the 'Technology' industry.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The search/filter panel is visible with 'Technology' selected in the Industry field, or the resulting list shows only Technology accounts.

task_completion.description: Agent selects all accounts that match the 'Technology' filter criteria.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Checkboxes next to the Technology accounts are checked, or the 'Select All' checkbox in the header is clicked while the filter is active.

task_completion.description: Agent opens the Mass Update panel/tool from the Actions menu.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Mass Update' option is selected from the 'Bulk Action' or 'Actions' dropdown, and the Mass Update form appears at the bottom or in a modal.

task_completion.description: Agent sets the 'Rating' field to 'Hot' within the Mass Update interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Mass Update panel shows the 'Rating' dropdown set to 'Hot' before the update is executed.

task_completion.description: Agent executes the update and verifies that exactly 6 accounts were updated to 'Hot'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks 'Update'. The final screen shows the list of Technology accounts now displaying 'Hot' in the Rating column. Exactly 6 accounts should be visible/affected.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to execute SQL queries to update the database directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal logs (if visible) do not show SQL update commands; the agent remains in the browser GUI for the update process.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the SuiteCRM UI elements rather than just navigating to a success URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the cursor or highlights on the Industry filter, checkboxes, and the Mass Update button.

integrity.description: The agent used the Mass Update feature as requested rather than editing 6 accounts individually.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen using the Bulk Action/Mass Update menu rather than clicking the 'Edit' pencil icon for each row one by one.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target industry is 'Technology' and the target rating is 'Hot'. There are exactly 6 accounts in the database that match the 'Technology' industry criteria. The agent must use the 'Mass Update' feature specifically.
